skills.name: Vermilion Shard
skills.description: Throw a burning jade shard that sets the target on fire for 4 s and shatters 3 armour for 6 s.

skills.name: Ninefold Ring
skills.description: A fire ring bursts 5 blocks around you, burning enemies 3 s; gain Resistance I 5 s per enemy hit, up to 3 stacks.

skills.name: Wisp Brand
skills.description: Mark a target for 12 s; if it dies, 3 soulfire bursts hit enemies within 4 blocks with soulburn for 4 s.

skills.name: Oni Hearth
skills.description: A 5-block area pulses for 6 s, healing allies 1 HP per second and soulburning enemies inside.

skills.name: Smoulder Step
skills.description: Dash 6 blocks leaving burning ground; your next hit within 3 s ignites the target for 5 s.

skills.name: Ember Garrote
skills.description: Strike the looked-at target within 4 blocks for bleeding and fire 6 s; double damage below 30% health.

skills.name: Firecracker Purse
skills.description: Throw a pouch that bursts into 5 small fire blasts in 3 blocks, knocking enemies back and burning them 3 s.

skills.name: Ember Tithe
skills.description: Mark a target for 15 s; if it dies burning, it drops one extra loot roll and erupts in 3-block flames.

skills.name: Signal Flare
skills.description: Fire a flare; enemies within 6 blocks of impact glow for 10 s and burn for 3 s.

skills.name: Pyre Quiver
skills.description: For 10 s your arrows ignite targets and deal +3 fire damage to targets already burning.

skills.name: Searing Sands
skills.description: Blast a 6-block cone of hot sand that blinds enemies 3 s and burns them 2 s.

skills.name: Sunbaked Flatbread
skills.description: Conjure flatbread; eating it grants Fire Resistance 60 s and Speed I 30 s.

skills.name: Brine Lance
skills.description: Throw a lance of icy brine that freezes the target 3 s and applies Slowness III for 4 s.

skills.name: Undertow Frost
skills.description: Pull all enemies within 6 blocks toward you and freeze them for 3 s.

skills.name: Polar Flash
skills.description: A 6-block cone of auroral light deals lightning damage, blinds 2 s and applies Slowness II 4 s.

skills.name: Borealis Veil
skills.description: For 10 s, attackers that hit you are struck by a small lightning bolt and frozen 2 s, once per 2 s.

skills.name: Hallowed Snowfall
skills.description: A 6-block area snows for 6 s, healing allies 1 HP per second with Resistance I and slowing undead.

skills.name: Sanctified Icicle
skills.description: Throw a holy icicle that freezes the target 3 s and deals double damage to undead.

skills.name: Winter Pact
skills.description: Sacrifice 4 HP to gain Absorption II and make your hits freeze targets 2 s for 10 s.

skills.name: Glacial Hex
skills.description: Mark a target with Weakness for 10 s; if it dies, frozen shards freeze enemies within 4 blocks for 4 s.

skills.name: Barrow Thrall
skills.description: Summon a frost-armoured zombie for 30 s that explodes on death, freezing enemies within 4 blocks 3 s.

skills.name: Hoarfrost Tithe
skills.description: Drain 2 HP from every enemy within 5 blocks, slowing them 4 s and healing you per enemy hit.

skills.name: Taiga Bulwark
skills.description: Raise a 5-wide wall of packed snow and spruce leaves in front of you for 10 s.

skills.name: Winterberry Bunch
skills.description: Conjure winterberries; eating grants Regeneration II 8 s and immunity to freezing for 60 s.

skills.name: Kagami Frost
skills.description: For 8 s, half of melee damage you take is reflected and freezes the attacker 2 s.

skills.name: Shiro Fracture
skills.description: Strike the looked-at target, freezing it 3 s and shattering 4 armour for 8 s.

skills.name: Yurei Breath
skills.description: Exhale a 5-block cone of ghostly cold that soulburns 3 s and applies Slowness II 4 s.

skills.name: Phantom Drift
skills.description: Glide 5 blocks through enemies, freezing every creature you pass for 2 s.

skills.name: Shatterstab
skills.description: Strike the looked-at target; if frozen, it takes triple damage and the freeze ends.

skills.name: Numbing Venom
skills.description: For 10 s your hits freeze targets 2 s and poison them 3 s.

skills.name: Slick Floor
skills.description: Coat the ground within 4 blocks in ice and gain Speed II for 5 s while enemies slip.

skills.name: Frozen Fingers
skills.description: Strike the looked-at target, freezing it 2 s and stealing one of its positive effects.

skills.name: Snowblind Shot
skills.description: Throw a packed snowball that blinds the target 3 s and applies Slowness II 5 s.

skills.name: Pinning Frost
skills.description: For 10 s your arrows freeze targets in place for 2 s.

skills.name: Snowshoe Bound
skills.description: Leap 8 blocks forward and gain Speed II for 10 s while on snow or ice.

skills.name: Nomad Stew
skills.description: Conjure a hot stew; eating grants Absorption II and Speed I for 60 s.

skills.name: Galvanic Downpour
skills.description: A 6-block area rains for 6 s, dealing lightning damage each second, doubled against wet enemies.

skills.name: Stormsurge Leap
skills.description: Leap 10 blocks forward; on landing, lightning strikes enemies within 3 blocks.

skills.name: Blessed Font
skills.description: A 5-block font pulses for 6 s, healing allies 2 HP every 2 s and extinguishing fire.

skills.name: Mercy Wave
skills.description: A 6-block wave cone heals allies 4 HP and pushes enemies back 4 blocks.

skills.name: Abyssal Tether
skills.description: Strike the looked-at target within 12 blocks, pulling it to you with Weakness for 5 s.

skills.name: Leviathan Hex
skills.description: Mark a target to take 1 drowning damage per second for 6 s; if it dies, you heal 4 HP.

skills.name: Crown of Brine
skills.description: For 15 s each kill raises a trident-wielding drowned ally for 20 s.

skills.name: Brackish Bile
skills.description: Throw a bile flask; enemies within 3 blocks get Poison II 4 s and Nausea 6 s.

skills.name: Mangrove Thicket
skills.description: Raise a ring of mangrove roots around you for 8 s that blocks enemies.

skills.name: Bogberry Brew
skills.description: Conjure a brew; drinking grants Regeneration I 15 s and Water Breathing 60 s.

skills.name: Shattering Current
skills.description: A 6-block water cone knocks enemies back and shatters 3 armour for 6 s.

skills.name: Koi Leap
skills.description: Dash 6 blocks forward and gain Dolphin's Grace and Speed I for 10 s.

skills.name: Bottomless Ladle
skills.description: Strike the looked-at target, filling its lungs: drowning damage for 3 s and soulburn 4 s.

skills.name: Tolling Bell
skills.description: A ghost-bell ring hits enemies within 6 blocks with Glowing and Slowness II for 5 s.

skills.name: Siren's Lure
skills.description: Pull enemies in an 8-block cone toward you and apply Weakness for 4 s.

skills.name: Seafoam Vanish
skills.description: Become invisible with Speed II for 3 s; your first hit out of it deals +6 damage.

skills.name: Grapeshot Blast
skills.description: Fire a 6-block cone of scattershot dealing 6 damage and strong knockback.

skills.name: Walk the Plank
skills.description: Shove the creature you look at 6 blocks away and soak it: Slowness II and Wet for 6 s.

skills.name: Spearfisher's Focus
skills.description: For 10 s hits on wet or swimming targets deal +50% damage and pull them 2 blocks closer.

skills.name: Ink Bomb
skills.description: Throw an ink sac that blinds enemies within 3 blocks of impact for 4 s.

skills.name: Sea Legs
skills.description: For 20 s gain Dolphin's Grace, Water Breathing and immunity to knockback.

skills.name: Harbour Light
skills.description: Place a light pillar for 15 s giving allies within 8 blocks Night Vision and Regeneration I.

skills.name: Divine Verdict
skills.description: Mark a target for 10 s; if it dies, lightning strikes the 3 nearest enemies.

skills.name: Thunder Halo
skills.description: A 5-block thunder ring stuns enemies 2 s and heals allies 4 HP.

skills.name: Eldritch Arc
skills.description: Throw a cursed spark that chains to 3 enemies, applying Wither for 4 s.

skills.name: Malign Current
skills.description: For 10 s each kill releases a lightning burst hitting enemies within 3 blocks.

skills.name: Voltaic Revenant
skills.description: Summon a charged husk for 20 s with Speed II whose hits chain lightning to one nearby enemy.

skills.name: Necrotic Static
skills.description: A 5-block area pulses for 5 s, dealing 2 damage to enemies and healing your summons.

skills.name: Thunderseed
skills.description: Throw a seed that sprouts and calls lightning on impact after 2 s, granting nearby allies Regeneration I.

skills.name: Stag's Crown
skills.description: For 12 s your melee hits knock enemies back 3 blocks and grant you Speed I for 3 s.

skills.name: Raiko Fracture
skills.description: Strike the looked-at target, shattering 5 armour; if its armour reaches 0, it is stunned 2 s.

skills.name: Mirror Bolt
skills.description: Dash 6 blocks; a lightning echo at your start point strikes enemies within 3 blocks after 1 s.

skills.name: Shimenawa Circle
skills.description: A 6-block ring soulburns enemies 4 s with Slowness I and gives allies Speed I for 6 s.

skills.name: Onigiri Offering
skills.description: Conjure a rice ball; eating grants Speed I and Haste II for 45 s.

skills.name: Static Edge
skills.description: For 10 s your hits from behind stun the target for 1.5 s.

skills.name: Bolt Kunai
skills.description: Throw a kunai that calls a small lightning strike on hit and makes the target glow 6 s.

skills.name: Shock Purse
skills.description: Throw a coin pouch that stuns enemies within 3 blocks of impact for 2 s.

skills.name: Blink Fuse
skills.description: For 6 s, the first time you are hit you teleport 5 blocks away and gain Speed III 3 s.

skills.name: Ball Lightning
skills.description: Launch a slow orb that zaps enemies within 2 blocks of its path every half second.

skills.name: Conductive Mark
skills.description: Mark a target to glow 12 s; arrows hitting it chain lightning to 2 nearby enemies.

skills.name: Wandering Storm
skills.description: For 15 s, while sprinting, enemies within 3 blocks are zapped every second.

skills.name: Storm Jerky
skills.description: Conjure jerky; eating grants Speed II and Jump Boost II for 30 s.

skills.name: Broken Halo
skills.description: Throw a shattered halo that applies Wither 3 s to the target and heals you 2 HP.

skills.name: Fallen Grace
skills.description: For 10 s each kill grants you Absorption I and heals allies within 5 blocks 2 HP.

skills.name: Salt Circle
skills.description: A 4-block salt ring pulses for 6 s, dealing 3 damage per second to undead and clearing Weakness from allies.

skills.name: Bound Shade
skills.description: Summon 2 allied vexes for 20 s whose hits make targets glow.

skills.name: Heartwood Shelter
skills.description: Raise a small azalea dome for 10 s that gives Regeneration II to allies inside.

skills.name: Bloom Lash
skills.description: A 5-block cone of vines roots enemies with Slowness V 3 s and heals allies 3 HP.
